description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeCSVImportAPI in the OrangeHRM project. The test covers methods for deleting, validation rules, retrieving all entries, and creating CSV import jobs through the API. It verifies API behavior including validation, exception handling, and the interaction with the PimCsvDataImportService.
